purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Official sources describe Zhangzhou Land Supermarket as a WeChat mini-program marketplace for selected marketed low-efficiency land, not as a cadastral registry layer. The April 2025 launch listed 208 parcels; a November 2025 official follow-up reported 350 listed and 19 transacted, showing that the count is time-dependent. Published descriptions and the public screenshot show map browsing/location and listing cards, but no parcel-boundary geometry, safe native parcel-ID field, or anonymous vector schema was verified. An ordinary anonymous GET to the linked municipal bureau host timed out. No parcel geometry was retained.
registryAssessment: Municipal registration and planning systems are confirmed; the selected, time-varying Land Supermarket listings does not establish all-parcel or WUP-point cadastral coverage.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Fujian Provincial Department of Natural Resources identifies the official Zhangzhou Natural Resources Bureau site, Fujian online real-property registration application system, and Tianditu Fujian links.
Official launch article (April 2025) reports an initial 208 selected marketed parcels and describes map browsing/listing details; later official reporting shows the supply count changes over time.

Provincial natural-resources report describes Zhangzhou’s “One Map” system holding 106 categories/512 data types for municipal/county operational planning and resource administration; it is described as an internal management system, not a public cadastre.

Provincial natural-resources homepage links this official Fujian online real-property registration application system; the site did not resolve in the web page reader, and no account/authentication was attempted.
Official Zhangzhou Natural Resources Bureau site linked from the provincial department. It timed out through the public page reader; its anonymous parcel service/schema could not be inspected.
Official November 2025 follow-up reports 350 Land Supermarket listings and 19 transactions, confirming that marketplace inventory is time-dependent.

Official Fujian Government description says the Land Supermarket offers selected rights-clear low-efficiency land with location, area, use, current-use status, and map/remote-sensing functions; this is a marketed supply inventory, not a complete cadastral layer.
Official provincial answer identifies 漳州土地超市 as a WeChat mini-program; no standalone public web client or API schema was documented in the reviewed source.
Official launch screenshot fetched anonymously (HTTP 200) shows a map with location markers and listing cards; it does not establish parcel-boundary vectors or an API schema.
